attr.title: Scott Pilgrim EX
attr.desc: Explore a fractured Toronto as Scott Pilgrim, Ramona Flowers and their allies in a pixel-art action-adventure brawler. Chain attacks, wield weapons, complete quests and customize your fighter with badges.
attr.inst: Place your legally obtained PC Scott Pilgrim EX game files in <ports directory>/scottpilgrimex/gamedata/. See README.md for exact Steam downloads and owned DLC transfer.
